exposure: Gestational age at delivery (40 0/7-40 6/7 weeks vs 41 0/7-41 6/7 weeks)
finding: Low-risk women who delivered at 40 0/7 to 40 6/7 weeks had lower rates of cesarean sections, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, episiotomies, and macrosomia compared to those who delivered at 41 0/7 to 41 6/7 weeks.
